Huawei NetEngine AR700 series routers are next-generation high-performance routers. They use ARM-based multi-core processors and a non-blocking switching architecture, providing twice the industry average performance. Additionally, they integrate diverse functions such as 5G, routing, switching, VPN, security, and MPLS, enabling diversified enterprise services in the cloud era.

The Huawei NetEngine AR720 is a high-performance enterprise-class router designed to deliver fast, reliable, and secure connectivity for medium to large business networks. Featuring 2x Gigabit WAN Combo Ports and 8x Gigabit Ethernet LAN Ports, the AR720 supports flexible deployment in various enterprise network scenarios.

Built on Huawei’s advanced NetEngine platform, the AR720 ensures robust routing, security, and intelligent traffic management. It integrates VPN, firewall, QoS, and IPv6 support, making it ideal for high-throughput, low-latency environments.

With centralized management capabilities and modular scalability, this router is perfect for organizations looking to optimize WAN performance, branch connectivity, and hybrid cloud integration.


Key Features:

  • Model: Huawei NetEngine AR720

  • WAN Ports: 2 x Gigabit Combo (RJ45/SFP)

  • LAN Ports: 8 x Gigabit Ethernet

  • Routing Performance: Enterprise-grade, high throughput

  • Security Features: Built-in firewall, IPSec VPN, ACLs

  • Management: Web UI, CLI, SNMP, Huawei eSight platform

  • Advanced Functions:

    • Load balancing

    • Static and dynamic routing (RIP, OSPF, BGP)

    • NAT, DHCP, QoS

    • IPv4 & IPv6 dual stack

  • Design: Fanless or low-noise cooling with compact form factor

  • Reliability: Carrier-class stability and long uptime


Ideal Use Cases:

  • Enterprise branch connectivity

  • Campus or head office networks

  • Secure VPN gateway for remote sites

  • WAN optimization and hybrid cloud deployment
